name: easyeda-pro-control
description: Safety-gated EasyEDA adapters, narrow symbol/PCB workflows and seven engineering skills.

interface.longDescription: Seven skills cover EasyEDA Pro control, schematic design, PCB layout, component libraries, manufacturing release, design review and extension development. Version-pinned typed API adapters distinguish public subsets, native equivalents, blocked implementations and documented omissions. Discovery does not grant execution support. The legacy batch writer remains runtime-disabled. Dispatcher ded07x99dcxb504 is connected-read-admitted only on its reviewed tuple; future mismatches fail closed. Current readers cover calculations, metadata, PCB layers, loaded identities and bounded geometry, not complete saved-design inventories. Writing remains limited to eligible unused project-local symbol metadata and schematic-container titles, with separate disposable symbol-copy and PCB-title workflows. Each write needs original ownership, current runtime admission, complete closed-database effect checks and fresh saved readback. General schematic/PCB geometry, referenced-symbol propagation and library writers remain unfinished. The launch-sealed String precreate workflow qualifies original PCB/project-worker sources and offers an optional common-baseline comparison before two fixed observation sweeps. The common stage retains the original pre-open SQL reader and five raw replies; copied evidence cannot recreate it. A stored-comparison refusal permits the independent precreate read only after successful cleanup, fresh context checks and durable failure/result publication. Other failures require normal cleanup. None of these observations creates geometry, invokes Save or grants writer eligibility. The new teardrop-owner discovery checks six original bound callbacks, exact target bodies/locations, empty bound arguments and one shared receiver, without invoking them or assuming an omitted Zec closure binding. Constructor and callback refusals retain bounded primary diagnostics separately from cleanup failures. Private worker gate/publisher profiles preserve deployment, read-only and synchronization state but do not establish isolation, complete receivers or publication containment. Installed233238 passed opening and PCB/worker source qualification, then refused constructor discovery; original normal closure and release passed with unchanged disposable bytes. New integration still needs connected validation. Lazy-manager support, hidden arrow receivers, complete effects, separate Save clocks and the full saved/reopened writer lifecycle remain unfinished. Startup and opening use the existing profile and may restore tabs, migrate, replay caches or automatically Save; they are not isolated. Ambiguous calls stay consumed. Inspection, normal closure, proved root/Job termination, helper release and durable settlement are separate steps. No Save/Discard choice, forced termination, blind retry, caller JavaScript or unrestricted Save is supported. Lost ownership cannot be reconstructed from journals. Missing installation files select offline-only startup. The installed-catalog checker uses a separate synthetic profile, not the live owner. Consult the skills and exhaustive coverage inventory for each supported subset and remaining work.
defaultPrompt: Validate the EasyEDA bridge without bypassing compatibility gates.
Inspect the admitted EasyEDA project with exact readers and managed evidence.
Apply the requested typed design change and verify it after saving and reopening.
